AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This app plays internet radio stations that the user has already saved to their list.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'playStation' to start playing a saved station by its display name. - Use 'stopPlayback' to stop whatever is currently playing.
Constraints: - Only stations already in the user's saved list can be played; this app cannot add new stations or play arbitrary URLs.
